game: Electoral Strategy: Campaign for the Presidency

cards.name: Universal Healthcare Plan
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in states with High Healthcare Priority (MA, NY, CA, OR, WA)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in states with Low Tax Priority (TX, FL, NH, TN)
cards.flavor_text: Quality healthcare is a right, not a privilege.

cards.name: Lower Prescription Costs
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Senior-heavy states (FL, AZ, PA)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Pharma-industry states (NJ, CT)
cards.flavor_text: Families shouldn't choose between medicine and meals.

cards.name: Health Savings Accounts
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Business-friendly states (TX, GA, NC)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Union-heavy states (MI, WI, PA)
cards.flavor_text: Put healthcare decisions back in your hands.

cards.name: Mental Health Initiative
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Youth-heavy states (CO, OR, MN, VA)
cards.special: Can be played in combination with Education cards for +1 bonus
cards.flavor_text: Breaking the silence, healing our communities.

cards.name: Middle Class Tax Cut
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in ALL swing states
cards.backlash: -1 lean in High-income states (CT, MA, NJ, CA)
cards.flavor_text: More money in your pocket, not Washington's.

cards.name: Infrastructure Investment
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Rust Belt states (PA, MI, WI, OH)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Low-tax states (TX, FL, WY)
cards.special: If 'Union Support' card played this turn, +1 additional
cards.flavor_text: Rebuilding America, one bridge at a time.

cards.name: Small Business Relief
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in states with high small business density (All swing states)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in states with corporate headquarters (NY, CA, IL)
cards.flavor_text: The backbone of our economy deserves our support.

cards.name: Wall Street Reform
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Working-class states (PA, OH, MI, WI, WV)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Financial centers (NY, CT, IL)
cards.flavor_text: When they prosper, you should too.

cards.name: Corporate Tax Cut
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Business states (TX, FL, GA, NC, TN)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Progressive states (CA, NY, MA, VT)

cards.name: Minimum Wage Increase
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Service-industry states (NV, FL, HI)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Small-business states (NH, MT, WY)
cards.flavor_text: A full day's work deserves a fair day's pay.

cards.name: Green Energy Initiative
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Climate-priority states (CA, OR, WA, CO, VT)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Fossil-fuel states (WV, WY, ND, TX, LA)

cards.name: Oil & Gas Independence
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Energy-production states (TX, LA, OK, ND, AK)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Environmental states (CA, OR, WA, VT)

cards.name: Nuclear Energy Expansion
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Tech-forward states (CA, WA, GA, TX)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in states near nuclear incidents or concerns
cards.flavor_text: Clean, reliable power for the 21st century.

cards.name: Conservation & Parks
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Outdoor recreation states (CO, MT, UT, OR, WA, AK)
cards.flavor_text: Preserving our natural heritage for generations.

cards.name: Border Security
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Border states with security concerns (TX, AZ)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Immigrant-heavy states (CA, NM, NV, FL)

cards.name: Path to Citizenship
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in High-immigration states (CA, TX, FL, NV, NM)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Immigration-skeptical states (AL, MS, WV)

cards.name: H1-B Visa Reform
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Tech-hub states (CA, WA, TX, MA, NY)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Manufacturing states (MI, OH, IN)

cards.name: Free Community College
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Young-voter states (All swing states, +VA, CO, NV)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Low-tax states (TX, FL, NH)

cards.name: Student Loan Forgiveness
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in High-debt states (CA, NY, PA, FL, TX)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Non-college states (WV, AR, MS)
cards.flavor_text: Lifting the burden of a generation.

cards.name: School Choice & Vouchers
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Urban states with school challenges (FL, OH, PA, MI)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Union-heavy states (CA, NY, MA, IL)

cards.name: Criminal Justice Reform
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Urban states (PA, MI, WI, GA, NC, AZ, NV)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Law-and-order states (TX, AL, MS)
cards.flavor_text: Justice should heal, not just punish.

cards.name: Law & Order Platform
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Suburban areas (swing state suburbs)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Urban cores (major cities)

cards.name: Gun Rights Protection
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Rural states (PA-rural, MI-rural, WI-rural, MT, WY, AK)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Urban states (NY, CA, IL, MA)

cards.name: Gun Safety Measures
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Suburban areas (PA, MI, WI, AZ suburbs)
cards.backlash: -2 lean in Rural areas
cards.flavor_text: Common sense for our children's safety.

cards.name: Military Funding Increase
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Military-base states (VA, NC, GA, TX, CA, FL)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Anti-war states (VT, OR, MA)

cards.name: Veterans Benefits Expansion
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in High-veteran states (FL, TX, CA, PA, VA, NC, GA)
cards.flavor_text: Keeping our promise to those who served.

cards.name: Tech Industry Investment
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in Tech hubs (CA, WA, TX, MA, NY, CO)
cards.backlash: -1 lean in Rural manufacturing (OH, MI, WI)

cards.name: Rural Broadband Expansion
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Rural swing states (PA, WI, MI, NC, GA, AZ)

cards.name: Grassroots Rally
cards.primary_effect: Choose 1 state. +2 lean immediately. Place Rally marker (ongoing +1 per turn for 3 turns)

cards.name: Town Hall Tour
cards.primary_effect: Choose 1 region (3-5 connected states). +1 lean in each
cards.special: Gain 1 bonus card draw next turn
cards.flavor_text: Listening to the people, not the pundits.

cards.name: Door-to-Door Campaign
cards.primary_effect: Choose 1 state. +1 lean. Immune to Attack Ads this turn

cards.name: Voter Registration Drive
cards.primary_effect: Choose 1 state. +1 lean per turn for next 3 turns

cards.name: Get Out The Vote (GOTV)
cards.primary_effect: Final 3 rounds only. Double all your bonuses in target state
cards.flavor_text: This is what democracy looks like!

cards.name: Positive Ad Campaign
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean in up to 3 states of your choice
cards.flavor_text: A message of hope and unity.

cards.name: Attack Ad
cards.primary_effect: Target opponent loses -2 lean in 1 state

outcomes.result: Backfires on you (-1 lean in that state)

cards.flavor_text: The people deserve to know the truth.

cards.name: Viral Social Media Campaign
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in states with young voters (under 40)

cards.name: Debate Performance
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in ALL swing states
cards.special: Can only be played during designated Debate rounds

cards.name: Presidential Endorsement
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean in 1 state, +1 lean in adjacent states
cards.flavor_text: Standing on the shoulders of giants.

cards.name: Celebrity Endorsement
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in 1 urban/suburban state

outcomes.result: Backfires! Celebrity says something controversial (-1 lean in rural areas)

cards.name: Crisis Management
cards.primary_effect: Block 1 Attack Ad or negate 1 scandal effect
cards.special: Can be played on opponent's turn (instant)

cards.name: Opposition Research
cards.primary_effect: Look at opponent's hand. Choose 1 card to discard

cards.name: Recount Demand
cards.primary_effect: Reset 1 state to its starting lean position
cards.special: Can only be used on states won by opponent in last 2 turns

cards.name: Pivot Strategy
cards.primary_effect: Discard up to 3 cards, draw 3 new cards

cards.name: Hail Mary
cards.primary_effect: Final 2 rounds only. All-in gamble on 1 state

outcomes.result: Desperation shows (+2 in target, -3 everywhere else)
Calculated risk (+3 in target, -2 everywhere else)
Lightning in a bottle! (+5 in target, -1 everywhere else)

cards.name: Major Donor Event
cards.primary_effect: Gain 4 Campaign Points next turn
cards.special: Can only play 1 fundraising card per turn

cards.name: Small Dollar Donations
cards.primary_effect: Gain 2 Campaign Points now, +1 lean in 1 grassroots state
cards.flavor_text: Powered by the people, $27 at a time.

cards.name: Super PAC Support
cards.primary_effect: Gain 5 Campaign Points, but -1 lean in Progressive states

cards.name: Email Fundraising Blast
cards.primary_effect: Gain 1 Campaign Point per state where you currently lead

cards.name: Economic Recession
cards.primary_effect: -2 lean for incumbent party in ALL states. Economy policy cards cost +1 Campaign Point
cards.flavor_text: Markets tumble as uncertainty grips the nation.

cards.name: Stock Market Boom
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean for incumbent party in Wealthy states (CT, NJ, MA, CA). -1 lean for challenger in Working-class states

cards.name: Unemployment Report: Jobs Added
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean for incumbent in ALL states
cards.flavor_text: Strongest job growth in a decade.

cards.name: Unemployment Report: Jobs Lost
cards.primary_effect: -2 lean for incumbent in Rust Belt states (PA, MI, WI, OH)

cards.name: Gas Price Spike
cards.primary_effect: -1 lean for incumbent in ALL states. Energy policy cards get +1 effectiveness

cards.name: Trade War Begins
cards.primary_effect: -2 lean in Export-dependent states (IA, NE, WA, CA). +1 lean in Manufacturing states (MI, OH, PA, WI)

cards.name: Federal Reserve Rate Change
cards.primary_effect: +1 or -1 lean for incumbent (depending on rate direction) in states with high mortgage rates

cards.name: International Crisis
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean for incumbent in Military states (VA, NC, TX, CA, GA). All players can play Defense policy cards at -1 cost

cards.name: Terrorist Attack
cards.primary_effect: +3 lean for incumbent nationally. Defense/Security policy cards get +2 effectiveness. Decay -1 lean per round after initial shock

cards.name: Peace Treaty Signed
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean for incumbent in Progressive states. -1 lean for incumbent in Defense-industry states
cards.flavor_text: A new era of diplomacy begins.

cards.name: Military Scandal
cards.primary_effect: -2 lean for incumbent in ALL states

cards.name: Successful Military Operation
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean for incumbent in ALL states

cards.name: International Trade Deal
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean for incumbent in Export states (IA, NE, KS, WA, CA). -1 lean in Manufacturing states (OH, MI, PA, WI)

cards.name: Hurricane/Natural Disaster
cards.primary_effect: Choose 1 coastal state. -3 lean for incumbent in that state. Infrastructure policy cards get +2 effectiveness in affected state
cards.special: Strong disaster response can flip to +1 lean

cards.name: Mass Shooting
cards.primary_effect: Gun policy cards (both sides) get +3 effectiveness. -1 lean for incumbent nationally

cards.name: Police Violence Incident
cards.primary_effect: Criminal Justice policy cards get +3 effectiveness. -2 lean in Urban areas, +1 lean in Rural areas (varies by response)

cards.name: Healthcare Crisis/Pandemic
cards.primary_effect: -3 lean for incumbent in ALL states. Healthcare policy cards cost -1 and get +2 effectiveness
cards.special: Strong healthcare response can flip to +2 lean

cards.name: Supreme Court Ruling
cards.primary_effect: Varies by ruling. +2/-2 lean in states aligned/opposed to decision. Social Issue cards get +2 effectiveness
cards.flavor_text: A landmark decision divides the nation.

cards.name: Political Scandal
cards.primary_effect: Target player (draw randomly): -3 lean in ALL states

cards.name: Wildfire Season
cards.primary_effect: -2 lean for incumbent in Western states (CA, OR, WA, CO, AZ, NM). Environment policy cards get +2 effectiveness

cards.name: Youth Climate Movement
cards.primary_effect: Environment policy cards get +2 effectiveness. +1 lean in states with young voters for climate-forward policies

cards.name: Union Strike Wave
cards.primary_effect: Labor-friendly policies get +2 effectiveness. -1 lean for incumbent in Union states (MI, WI, PA, OH, NV)
cards.flavor_text: Workers walk off the job nationwide.

cards.name: Religious Movement
cards.primary_effect: Social Issue cards get +2 effectiveness. +2/-2 lean in religious states depending on policy alignment

cards.name: Cybersecurity Breach
cards.primary_effect: -1 lean for incumbent in Tech states. Technology policy cards cost -1

cards.name: AI Breakthrough
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Tech hub states (CA, WA, TX, MA). -1 lean in Automation-threatened states (MI, OH, PA, WI)

cards.name: The Military Hero
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean in all Military states (permanent)
cards.special: One-time ability: Neutralize one Foreign Affairs crisis

cards.name: The Popular Governor
cards.primary_effect: +2 lean in Running Mate's home state (permanent)
cards.special: One-time ability: +1 lean in all adjacent states for 1 round

cards.name: The Young Progressive
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean with voters under 40 in all states (permanent)

cards.name: The Moderate Swing-State Senator
cards.primary_effect: +1 lean in all Swing states (permanent)
cards.special: One-time ability: Reset 1 swing state to neutral

cards.name: Knockout Blow
cards.primary_effect: If you win: +3 lean in ALL swing states, opponent -2. If you lose: Your attack backfires, -2 lean in all swing states

cards.name: Steady Performance
cards.primary_effect: If you win: +2 lean in all states where you're currently losing. If you lose: +1 lean in states where you're losing (still decent)

cards.name: Gaffe Recovery
cards.primary_effect: If you win: Nullify opponent's effect + gain +1 lean nationally. If you lose: Opponent's card takes full effect
cards.special: If opponent plays 'Knockout Blow' and you win, their card backfires on them
cards.flavor_text: Turning a stumble into a stride.

cards.name: October Surprise
cards.primary_effect: Final 2 rounds only. Play any Event card from discard pile

cards.name: Momentum Shift
cards.primary_effect: Swap lean positions of any 2 states
cards.flavor_text: The race just turned upside down.

cards.name: Media Blackout
cards.primary_effect: This round, no Attack Ads or negative campaigns can be played
